summary.problem: Local skills discovery fails when the 'description' field in SKILL.md frontmatter is a single line containing unquoted punctuation or colons.
summary.root_cause: When js-yaml fails to parse single-line frontmatter containing unquoted colons or special characters, parseFrontmatter falls back to parseSimpleFrontmatter, which may fail to cleanly parse or unquote single-line description values.
summary.context: Multi-line YAML scalars (using '>') do not trigger syntax errors in js-yaml, which is why multi-line descriptions succeed while unquoted single-line descriptions fail.

steps: Update parseFrontmatter and parseSimpleFrontmatter in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.ts to robustly parse single-line description fields.
Ensure field values (name and description) extracted by js-yaml or fallback parser are properly converted to strings and trimmed.
Ensure parseSimpleFrontmatter properly strips surrounding quotes from single-line description values.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Skills with single-line descriptions in SKILL.md frontmatter are parsed and discovered successfully during skill loading.
verification_steps: Add test cases in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.test.ts for loading skills with single-line descriptions containing punctuation and colons.
Run unit tests with Vitest to ensure loadSkillsFromDir discovers skills with both single-line and multi-line descriptions.

github_metadata.title: [Bug] Skills discovery fails when 'description' in SKILL.md frontmatter is a single line
